title: TimeInteract: Towards Real-Time Interactive Intelligence for Streaming Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2609.26389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world time series evolve continuously, with meaningful changes potentially emerging at any moment. However, existing time-series language models (TSLMs) remain inherently static. They either receive complete sequences for offline processing or alternate between streaming input and response generation, which prevents processing of new observations during interaction. We introduce a new regime, Time-Series Interaction: a model continuously perceives incoming time-series observations and user intent, autonomously decides when to remain silent or respond, and continues processing new observations during response generation. To realize this, we develop TimeInteract with three key designs: a dual-view streaming TS encoder that captures local variations and historical dynamics, a response control mechanism that learns when to trigger a response, and a decoupled streaming inference mechanism that separates control from response generation t

translated_title: TimeInteract：迈向流式时间序列的实时交互智能
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的时间序列持续演化，有意义的变化可能随时出现。然而，现有的时间序列语言模型（TSLMs）本质上仍是静态的：它们要么接收完整序列进行离线处理，要么在流式输入与响应生成之间交替进行，这导致无法在交互过程中处理新的观测数据。我们提出了一种新的范式——时间序列交互：模型持续感知传入的时间序列观测数据和用户意图，自主决定何时保持沉默或做出响应，并在响应生成过程中继续处理新的观测数据。为实现这一目标，我们开发了TimeInteract，其包含三个关键设计：能够捕获局部变化和历史动态的双视图流式时间序列编码器、学习何时触发响应的响应控制机制，以及将控制与响应生成分离的解耦流式推理机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了“时间序列交互”新范式并开发了TimeInteract模型，通过双视图流式编码器、响应控制机制和解耦流式推理机制三大设计，实现了对流式时间序列的实时感知、响应时机的自主决策，以及在生成响应的同时持续处理新观测数据的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the new Time-Series Interaction paradigm and the TimeInteract model, which achieves real-time perception of streaming time series, autonomous response timing, and continuous processing of new observations during response generation through three key designs: a dual-view streaming encoder, a response control mechanism, and a decoupled streaming inference mechanism.
